Notes: Libya administrative-procedures portal (ejraat.gov.ly, treated as national portal) lists 3 steps (request, pay LYD 3.5, collect) all at Passports & Nationality Authority branches; no online step. Documents include e-birth certificate, family status certificate and family booklet; Civil Registry site cra.gov.ly shows only 'Coming Soon'.

ejraat.gov.ly describes 4 in-person steps (appointment obtained at counter, photo, pay LYD 50.5, collect); documents include birth and family status certificates and family booklet. nid.gov.ly lists an e-service for passport appointment booking (reservation.nid.gov.ly) but it failed to load (TLS certificate name mismatch), so online booking could not be observed and was not credited.

ejraat.gov.ly lists 7 steps for corporate income tax, all at the Tripoli tax office; tax.gov.ly offers only downloadable forms and receipt/certificate look-ups, and its e-portal text has no working entry point. C4=0 because the stamp-duty receipt issued by the same tax office must be presented; tax.gov.ly footer carries injected spam links.

Ministry of Interior page gives documents and says the file is lodged at the police or national guard post; only a downloadable form is online. Birth extract and proof of nationality required; national portal services.gov.tn Interior section lists only casier judiciaire services.

finances.gov.tn 'Vente de vignettes' gives tariffs and deadlines only; the Finance Ministry online platform taxe-circulation.finances.gov.tn refused connection (ECONNREFUSED) from curl, WebFetch and browser, so the most digital path could not be observed and C1, C2, C3, C9, C12 are left blank (R4). Not found on services.gov.tn.

GAFI: incorporation 'conducted exclusively online' - upload documents, pay fees by credit card, sign articles and notarisation record electronically, final documents delivered via Investor Service Center or Egypt Post; channel listed as electronic portal only. Login is a GAFI portal username/password account; founders' national ID copies required; Digital Egypt hosts only the trade-name reservation step, not incorporation.

Digital Egypt public-shop licence service: apply and pay fees online, but complete documents are reviewed by the competent licensing centre before the licence is collected and the online request is not itself a licence. Login via Egypt Pass national digital identity (di.gov.eg); ID and commercial register required.

DHA: parents 'must visit the nearest Home Affairs office' with proof of birth and their ID/passport (marriage certificate where applicable); forms provided at offices. gov.za 'Register birth' page summarises and links to DHA.

eHomeAffairs: submit Smart ID application, attach documents, pay online and book a bank-branch appointment, but 'a branch visit is mandatory' for biometrics and the card is collected at the office; login is ID number + password + OTP. DHA also offers application at participating bank branches and finalising at any Home Affairs office; first issue needs certified birth certificate and parents' ID; gov.za links out to DHA.

Absher: citizens renew the national ID online with face recognition and the card is delivered to the registered address without visiting Civil Affairs offices; delivery fee paid in the request. Absher account is a digital ID activated via Nafath/bank/kiosk; only a photo is requested and the registered address is reused. my.gov.sa page (services/143495) blocked by Cloudflare 403, C5 based on its search-index listing pointing to Absher.

Absher: renew the Saudi passport electronically without visiting passport offices; FAQ says fees are paid via bank account and the renewed passport is sent to the national address by Saudi Post after the old passport is handed to the postal employee (coded 3; a stricter reading of that hand-over would give 2). my.gov.sa page (services/112090) blocked by Cloudflare 403; C5 from its search-index listing.

ZATCA: file CIT/zakat return in the e-portal, SADAD invoice payable by SADAD/mada/Visa, zakat certificate issued automatically in the portal; Required Documents 'No Documents'; service channel website only. Login offers TIN/email+password or Nafath; my.gov.sa listings (blocked, seen in search index) point to the ZATCA portal.

Gov24: reissue can be applied for online (or by visit) with fee 5,000/10,000 KRW, but the card is issued at the eup/myeon/dong office after in-person identity check and cannot be collected by proxy (Nowon-gu notice). Login includes mobile ID and joint certificate; page lists documents officials verify via administrative information sharing.

Gov24: holders of a previous e-passport can apply online, but online applicants must collect the passport in person at the counter (one visit); fee paid online (refund rules on Gov24 service page). Family relation, basic and resident registration certificates verified by officials; visit application at si/gun/gu passport offices named.

Gov24 issues the resident registration abstract immediately online as an electronic document, free of charge for internet issuance; attachments replaced by administrative information sharing; visit and kiosk channels named. Family relation certificate likewise issued free online 24/7 via efamily.scourt.go.kr with a certificate.
